missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Записка' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'лежит'. 'Короткая' is the agreeing feminine adjective describing the note.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Записку' is the accusative direct object of 'написал'. The feminine ending -а shifts to -у in the accusative singular. 'Тебе' marks the recipient.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Записке' takes the prepositional after 'в' to show where information was. The feminine ending becomes -е in the prepositional singular.

missions.phrase: Я не нашёл записки на двери.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Записки' takes the genitive after the negated verb 'не нашёл', showing the note was not found. The feminine genitive singular ends in -и here after к.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Записке' takes the dative after 'благодаря', meaning thanks to. The feminine dative singular ends in -е, identical to the prepositional here.
Strategic focus: Instrumental as means. 'Запиской' takes the instrumental, the case of the thing waved. The feminine instrumental singular ends in -ой.

missions.phrase: Я оставил тебе записку на кухне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Записку' is the accusative direct object of 'оставил'. 'Тебе' is the dative recipient and 'на кухне' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Записки' is the accusative plural object of 'собрал'. As an inanimate noun, the plural accusative matches the nominative plural in -и.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Записки' takes the genitive to show whose text it is. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive, linking the text to the note.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Записки' takes the genitive after 'без' to express absence. The feminine genitive singular ends in -и following к.
